items.title: Claude Developer Platform release notes: 2026-11-23
items.snippet: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 4.5 model ( claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and claude-opus-4-5 ), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for January 22, 2027. We recommend migrating to Claude Opus 5.5. See Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier . To check which dates apply on other platforms, see Model deprecations . · We’ve launched Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) in beta on Claude Platform , Claude Platform on AWS , and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) . EFS is Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible organizations that use Claude’s most capable models . Anthropic doesn’t retain your prompts and responses. Encrypted copies of them, called Sealed Safety Data, go to a bucket in your own cloud account. A workspace on Anthropic-managed storage isn’t on EFS, because Anthropic stores that workspace’s Sealed Safety Data. To get access, see Setup guide . · We’ve added two event types to organization webhooks , which are in beta. We send external_storage.failed when a bucket that you use as customer-owned storage fails our daily check, and external_storage.recovered when it passes again.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.331 → 2.1.331
items.snippet:
2.1.331
- Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS
- Added `oidc.groups_jsonpath` to the Claude apps gateway, to read groups from the matching entries of a list of objects with a small subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535)
- Added an API connectivity section to `claude doctor` that reports whether the API can be reached, with the HTTP status or the error, or says why it wasn't tested
- Added a notice when tap-mode voice dictation stops by itself, after 15 seconds without recognized speech or at its 2-minute limit
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_RESPONSE_COMPRESSION` to ask for uncompressed model responses behind a proxy that cuts compressed ones off; not advised yet for self-hosted runners or Remote Control
- Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1` for Claude apps gateways: with `oidc.use_proxy: true`, sign-in requests hand the proxy an `https` IdP's hostname even with `NO_PROXY` set
- Added `gen_ai.usage.*`, `gen_ai.response.model` and `gen_ai.operation.name` to `claude_code.llm_request` trace spans; `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` includes prompt cache tokens
- Added `optionalDependencies` to plugin manifests: plugins that install with the plugin listing them and can be disabled or uninstalled on their own

items.title: Page changed: Model deprecations
added: On November 23, 2026, Anthropic notified developers using Claude Opus 4.5 of its upcoming retirement on the Claude API.
This retirement includes claude-opus-4-5 , the same model’s ID without a date.
To migrate, see Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier in the Claude Opus 5.5 migration guide.
If you use Claude Code or a platform other than the Claude API, see Overview for which dates apply. For what to change, see Migrating to replacements .
removed: claude-opus-4-5-20251101 Active N/A Not sooner than November 24, 2026
